sentences.text:
The Hon'Ble Mr. Justice S.K. Sahoo
The Hon'Ble Miss. Justice Savitri Ratho Order No. Order 11.03.2025
01.
This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).

This writ petition has been filed by the petitioner, Mir Mahammad Hasimulla, for a direction to get the petitioner's sthitiban homestead land bearing plot no.4167, area Ac.0.075 decimal under hal khata no.1362 of Mouza-Gualsingh, Tahasil-Derabish, Dist-Kendrapara, free from forcible construction of concrete road over the same and free from the electricity wire and pipe line laid beneath the same within a stipulated period and with a further direction to pay fair compensation with penalty to the petitioner in lieu of such forcible act/acquisition of the petitioner's land.
Designation: Junior Stenographer Reason: Authentication Location: HIGH COURT OF ORISSA, CUTTACK Date: 12-Mar-2025 19:28:28

Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that when the petitioner approached this Court in W.P.(C) no.21699 of 2024, the same was disposed of vide order dated 13.09.2024 and the opp. party no.3, Tahasildar,
Derabish, was directed to take a lawful decision on the representation filed by the petitioner within a period of three months from the date of receipt of the representation.

Learned counsel further submitted that in pursuance of such order, the petitioner submitted the representation on 23.09.2024 before the opp. party no.3, who ordered the Revenue Inspector, Gualsingh Circle to cause field enquiry and the enquiry report dated 12.11.2024 has been submitted by the Revenue Inspector, Gualsingh Circle which would show that a public road has been constructed over the land of the petitioner.
Learned counsel further submitted that till date, no steps have been taken for acquiring the land nor has any compensation been paid to the petitioner.
Learned counsel for the State seeks some time to obtain instruction in the matter.
